page.overview:
What is Duén Hen?

The location features a fast-travel signpost, as well as a toppled, wooden statue used for prayer. If the shrine is restored as part of Defender of the Faith, a group of worshippers will gather here afterwards, despite the dangers posed by mucknixers and drowners that continually prowl nearby.
